proposal.reasoning: At the four-card economic target, test whether sparse distribution, one-card device rotation, broader non-micro amounts, and near one-BIN-per-card diversity reduce the strongest observable concentrations. Keep merchant friction low to limit decline-driven retries, and use the lowest permitted dead-card rate to preserve validation utility. First-seen recency remains largely unavoidable within this parameter space, while greater BIN diversity is the most expensive modeled adaptation.
